title: stachys germanica subsp. velezensis
intro: Stachys germanica subsp. velezensis, commonly known as Wood Betony, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This perennial herb has been used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Wood Betony include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
